title: World of Women
overview: Mizuhara Reito is an ordinary boy who wakes up in a world of 5 billion women and 5 men. Now it's up to him to repopulate the human species. Can he stay loyal to his missing childhood friend when all humankind is counting on him to sleep with as many girls as possible?

title: Two Women
overview: As Reito begins to adapt to this new, man-less world, he finds clues that the virus was artificially created.

title: 3rd Man
overview: A bullied teenage boy wakes up in the future after going into cold sleep. His new high school is filled with nothing but girls, and more than a few of them seem to have an interest in him, especially his old teacher.

title: School's Secret
overview: As Shouta adapts to his new life in the all-girls school, he starts to wonder why everyone is so eager to be friendly with him...

title: First Victim
overview: Reito goes to visit the widow of the very first victim of the MK Virus in Japan. The widow knows more than she should, and is secretly in contact with someone very important to him...

title: Intertwining Plots
overview: Reito finds clues leading to the origin of the MK virus. He also finds out that anybody who researches the origins of the virus tends to go missing quickly...

title: Assigned to Me
overview: The rivalry between the girls at school heats up as they all strive to be the one to mate with Shouta.

title: Revenge
overview: As Shouta becomes accustomed to life as the only boy at school, he starts to seek out more and darker thrills. And his keepers are more than happy to oblige his every need...

title: Feast of Debauchery
overview: As a messenger from UW's global headquarters arrives in Japan, Reito finds the secret behind the creation of the MK virus.

title: The Two Numbers
overview: The Numbers come under attack from terrorists calling themselves Izanami. But one of Izanami's leaders is the girl Reito's been searching for since he woke up.

title: Escape
overview: As UW World Headquarters solidifies its control over Japan, Reito escapes to Taiwan, where he will finally reunite with his beloved childhood friend.
